description.zh: 很有效率的武器，尤其受到壞村民軍團中的衛道士所愛用。
description.en: An effective weapon, favored by the relentless Vindicators of the Illager army.

description.zh: 最適合經驗老到且懂得自己製箭的獵人。
description.en: For the experienced hunter who knows how to fletch their own arrows.

description.zh: 杖端加裝配重，出手就能讓敵人心生畏懼。
description.en: With extra weights on the ends for striking fear into your enemies.

description.zh: 一把能釋放火焰、冰霜、毒素或雷電之力的強力法杖。
description.en: A powerful staff that unleashes the elements of fire, ice, poison and electricity on your enemies.

description.zh: 來自狼族夥伴的敬重獻禮，適合在滿月之下近身搏鬥。
description.en: A respectful offering from your wolf friends, for close combat beneath the full moon.

description.zh: 裝在手套上的一對利爪，讓你能在暗影中潛伏與聆聽。
description.en: A pair of sharp claws attached to gloves that let you sculk in the shadows.

description.zh: 一把巨劍，在正義戰士手中依然能得心應手。
description.en: A massive sword that rests easily in a righteous warrior's hands.

description.zh: 能讓你斬遍天下的雙手大劍……不必多說了。
description.en: A claymore that lets you slay more... No need to say more.

description.zh: 可靠的廚具，改裝後用來伸張正義。
description.en: A reliable kitchen cleaver repurposed for serving up justice.

description.zh: 神秘的剁肉刀，能把靈魂當作甜點端上桌。
description.en: A mystical meat cleaver that serves souls for dessert.

description.zh: 簡單的木製棍棒，用來好好給敵人當頭棒喝。
description.en: A simple wooden club for beating some sense into your enemies.

description.zh: 獻給喜歡在戰鬥間吃點心，並且不介意與寵物分享的戰士。
description.en: For the warrior who likes a snack in between fights, and who doesn’t mind sharing with their pets.

description.zh: 彎曲的巨劍，能把所有敵人修整成同樣的形狀與尺寸。
description.en: A curved greatsword that works all enemies into equal shape and size.

description.zh: 受到污染的劍，以呼嘯般的搖籃曲讓敵人沉沉睡去。
description.en: A tainted sword that puts your enemies to sleep with a swooshing lullaby.

description.zh: 彎曲的長劍，鋒利到彷彿能自行劃開隙浮……但其實並沒有。
description.en: A curved longsword with an edge so sharp it could open rifts of its own... It doesn’t, though.

description.zh: 鋒利的銅劍，鍛造來獻給平原上的高貴守護者。
description.en: A sharp copper sword forged as a gift to a noble protector of the plains.

description.zh: 盜賊行囊裡不可或缺的裝備。
description.en: A must-have in any rogue's inventory.

description.zh: 致命的匕首，刀鋒中灌注了靈魂之力。
description.en: A deadly dagger with a soul-infused edge.

description.zh: 當一把匕首已經不夠快的時候。
description.en: When one dagger just isn’t fast enough.

description.zh: 一對淬毒匕首，讓攻擊如蜘蛛之咬般致命。
description.en: A pair of poisoned daggers that make your strikes as deadly as a spider’s bite.

description.zh: 靈巧的刀刃，會對站在陰影下的敵人施以致命打擊。
description.en: A nimble blade that throws shade at anyone who stands beneath it.

description.zh: 鬥士之刃，是所有敵人的眼中釘。
description.en: A brawler’s blade that is a thorn in the side of all enemies.

description.zh: 握得越牢，打得越久。
description.en: You’ll go far if you stick with these.

description.zh: 一對亮眼的紅色戰鬥短棍，末端還點著燃燒的引信……你可能闖禍了。
description.en: A pair of snazzy red fighting sticks with burning fuses on the... You might have made a big mistake.

description.zh: 一雙強而有力的鋼製護拳，專為需要伸出援手的無助之人而生。
description.en: Powerful steel gauntlets for when the defenseless need a pair of helping hands.

description.zh: 一隻閃爍著雷電，另一隻附有冰霜，兩者都已準備好痛擊敵人。
description.en: One is crackling with electricity. The other is enchanted with ice. Both are primed for punching.

description.zh: 最適合喜歡直接解決問題的人。
description.en: For those who prefer a less subtle approach to problem solving.

description.zh: 取自巨獸的一部分，搭配巧妙的紅石火力工程，專門用來搞破壞。
description.en: A piece of a Monstrosity repurposed for wrecking with some resourceful fire engineering.

description.zh: 來玩一場經典的怪物打地鼠吧！
description.en: Let's play a good old game of whack-a-mob!

description.zh: 用轟鳴蟲殼骸製成的槌子，防守時同樣勢如猛擊。
description.en: A mallet made from humbler husk that guards as hard as it hits.

description.zh: 曾有位睿智的鐵匠把劍裝在長杖頂端，世界自此不再一樣。
description.en: A wise blacksmith once stuck a sword on top of a staff and the world has never been the same.

description.zh: 由純金打造的長柄刀，獻給率先衝鋒的勇敢戰士。
description.en: A glaive of pure gold for the brave warrior who leads the charge.

description.zh: 好的斧頭滿足於單側開刃，而這把斧頭不只是好而已。
description.en: A good axe settles for having a blade on one side. This is no goodaxe.

description.zh: 既然這樣，一定有人不滿足於普通巨斧吧？
description.en: Why would anyone ever settle for a greataxe?

description.zh: 只要心懷正義，即使是最偉大的長劍也能輕如羽毛。
description.en: If your heart is just, even the greatest sword will feel light as a feather.

description.zh: 鍛造於深淵的傳奇之劍，刀身融入了紫水晶合金。
description.en: A legendary sword forged in the Deep Dark with amethyst alloy in the blade.

description.zh: 專門對付剛好打不到的敵人，還能搔到難以觸及的癢處。
description.en: For enemies just out of range and itches in hard-to-reach places.

description.zh: 附魔長戟，能為所有需要保護的人召喚護盾。
description.en: An enchanted halberd with the power to conjure shields around all who need protection.

description.zh: 打鐵要趁熱，出手時更要趁熱。
description.en: Strike while the iron is still hot.

description.zh: 這把鋼鎚摻入了綠寶石合金，據說能為持有者帶來非凡的幸運。
description.en: This steel hammer with emerald alloy is said to bring extraordinary luck to its wielder.

description.zh: 在沒有方位概念的世界裡，始終指向真正的北方。
description.en: Always points to your true north, in a world without cardinal directions.

description.zh: 這長槍能賦予隙浮守護者所向披靡的力量。
description.en: A lance that grants a true defender of the Sift with unstoppable powers.

description.zh: 殘忍的戰爭工具，看起來雖然不甚靈巧，但卻力量強大。
description.en: A brutal tool of war, but what it lacks in finesse it makes up for in power.

description.zh: 硬如鋼釘、輕若羽毛，這把重錘非常適合翻滾與跳躍攻擊。
description.en: Hard as nails but light as a feather, this mace is perfect for rolling and jumping attacks.

description.zh: 為新維度打造的收割工具，最適合用來收割靈魂。
description.en: A harvest tool for the new dimension, perfect for reaping souls.

description.zh: 讓敵人站立不穩，正好迎接收割時刻。
description.en: Leave your enemies reeling and ripe for the reaping.

description.zh: 自記憶所及，冒險家和英雄最常使用的經典工具。
description.en: The iconic tool of adventurers and heroes for as long as anyone can remember.

description.zh: 獻給懷念那段單純挖掘綠寶石歲月的人們。
description.en: The chosen weapon for those who miss the good old days of simple emerald mining.

description.zh: 敵人遇到你時，絕不會想嘗到棍子另一端的滋味。
description.en: Enemies won’t want to get the wrong end of the stick when they run into you.

description.zh: 將魔法避雷針裝在銅製長矛上，就能以各種花樣打擊敵人。
description.en: A magic lightning rod attached to a copper pike that can strike your enemies in more ways than one.

description.zh: 纖細而靈巧的劍刃，出手迅捷而兇猛。
description.en: A nimble and narrow blade that strikes with fierce ferocity.

description.zh: 專為擊劍高手打造的靈巧之劍，攻擊速度凌駕其他刀刃。
description.en: A nimble sword for the fencing virtuoso that strikes faster than other blades.

description.zh: 微微彎曲的長劍，適合在戰場上大開大闔。
description.en: A slightly curved sword for when you want to paint with broad strokes.

description.zh: 獻給那些愛在泥地裡翻滾、調皮搗蛋的戰士。
description.en: For mischieveous warriors who like rolling around in the mud.

description.zh: 這把大鐮刀能分得出良莠，因此只適合那些埋頭苦幹的戰士。
description.en: Fit only for toiling warriors, the scythe truly separates the wheat from the chaff.

description.zh: 這把大鐮刀的刀刃鑲有靈魂方塊的碎片，會將所有靈魂拉近。
description.en: A scythe with a shard of soul block for a blade, that draws all souls towards you.

description.zh: 只要使用得當，就算是短矛也能跨越維度。
description.en: With the right wielder, even a short spear can reach across dimensions.

description.zh: 以靈漿鍛造、並被靈魂附身的長矛，會灼燒你所指向的一切敵人。
description.en: A spear forged in ichor and possessed by souls that will burn all enemies you point at.

description.zh: 較為輕巧的手杖，適合在近距離迅速制敵。
description.en: A lighter quarterstaff for swift takedowns in close quarters.

description.zh: 虹彩絢麗的戰鬥手杖，總是能命中目標。
description.en: A beautiful iridescent fighting cane that always hits its target.

description.zh: 同時為你提供長劍的力量和匕首的迅捷。
description.en: When you need the strength of a sword but the swiftness of a dagger.

description.zh: 被逼到角落時，這把劍會賦予你額外的力量。
description.en: When you’re backed into a corner, this sword will grant you extra strength.

description.zh: 策劃復仇時，必須挖兩個墳墓：一個給敵人，另一個……給另一個敵人。
description.en: When planning for revenge, you must dig two graves: one for your enemy. And one... for your other enemy.

description.zh: 耐用的鑽石鏟，附魔後能將敵人震飛。
description.en: A durable diamond shovel enchanted with the power to blast enemies away.

description.zh: 蜂巢原野來的收割工具，改造後專門用來收割壞村民跟怪物。
description.en: Harvest tools from Honeycomb Fields, repurposed for reaping illagers and monsters.

description.zh: 由轟鳴蟲殼骸製成的雙鐮，兼具傷害與治療之力。
description.en: A pair of humbler husk sickles with the power to both harm and heal.

description.zh: 輕薄如針，鋒利程度也同樣……跟針一樣。
description.en: A blade as thin as a needle, but as sharp as a... as a needle.

description.zh: 這把利刃不只能奪走生命，還會吸血。
description.en: A blade that not only takes life but steals it.

description.zh: 鋒刃有如剃刀般銳利的長劍。
description.en: A mighty longsword with a razor-sharp edge.

description.zh: 注入冰霜之力的長劍，只有最冷酷的戰士配得上。
description.en: A frost-infused longsword fit only for the coolest of warriors.

description.zh: 劍，主世界誕生以來，英雄與倖存者最經典的武器。
description.en: A classic sword used by heroes and survivors since the dawn of the Overworld.

description.zh: 將火焰封存於鋼鐵之中，揮動時便會爆發而出。
description.en: A flame frozen into steel that erupts when you swing it.

description.zh: 什麼東西能比一把劍更棒呢？當然是兩把劍合而為一！
description.en: What could be better than a sword? Two swords stuck together of course!

description.zh: 風暴將至，而你正是龍捲風的中心。
description.en: There’s a storm coming. You are the eye of the tornado.

description.zh: 每次揮擊都會震撼大地，也撼動敵人的心臟。
description.en: Its strikes send tremors through the earth and through your enemies’ hearts.

description.zh: 以獄髓打造的戰鎚，注入了幽魂火焰的可怕魔法，命中時會引發爆炸。
description.en: A netherite war hammer imbued with ghastly fire magic that explodes on impact.

description.zh: 這雙足纏承載著失傳的防禦技藝，專為踢倒壞村民而設計。
description.en: Foot wraps from a forgotten art of defense, knitted for kicking the wits out of Illagers.

description.zh: 以隙浮材料製成的舒適襪子，專門用來把壞村民踢到失去理智。
description.en: A comfy pair of socks made from Sift materials, for kicking the wits out of Illagers.

description.zh: 獵人的最佳夥伴，改造後用來狩獵壞村民與怪物。
description.en: A hunter’s best friend, repurposed for hunting Illagers and monsters.

description.zh: 遊俠從不食言，正如這張弓從不失手。
description.en: A ranger never breaks a promise. This bow never misses its mark.

description.zh: 掠奪者戰士首選的遠程武器。
description.en: The ranged weapon of choice for the Pillager warriors.

description.zh: 朝敵人射出鎖鏈，將其牢牢釘在地面。沒有人能逃過鎖縛！
description.en: Shoot chains at enemies to pin them to the ground. Nobody escapes the Shackler!

description.zh: 當一把弩已經不夠用的時候。
description.en: When one crossbow just isn’t enough.

description.zh: 這種附魔弩會在翻滾時充能，射擊時釋放更強的威力。
description.en: These enchanted crossbows power up when you roll, firing with extra force.

description.zh: 這把巨型弩需要事先架設，隨後便會以愈來愈快的速度連續發射箭矢。
description.en: A giant crossbow that needs to be set up before it blasts arrows at an accelerating rate.

description.zh: 一把強力的弓，射出的箭矢力道驚人，連最頑強的敵人都能貫穿。
description.en: A powerful bow that fires with such force your arrows pierce even the toughest of enemies.

description.zh: 這把巨弓如轟鳴蟲的心臟般搏動著，能貫穿最堅硬的外殼。
description.en: This greatbow beats like the heart of a Humbler and pierces through the toughest husks.

description.zh: 行動緩慢卻致命，從遠距離便能構成真正的威脅。
description.en: A slow but deadly menace and a real threat from a distance.

description.zh: 貼近敵人，當面審判。
description.en: Judge your enemies up close and personal.

description.zh: 專為狩獵而打造，遠距離同樣致命。
description.en: Crafted for hunting but extremely effective at long range.

description.zh: 以嘎枝的枝幹製成，一擊承載著整片森林之力。
description.en: Made from the branch of a Creaking. Hits with the strength of an entire forest.

description.zh: 專為耐心的遊俠而生，不浪費任何一箭。
description.en: For the patient ranger who doesn’t like to waste arrows.

description.zh: 沉著拉弦，讓箭矢知道你是秉持正義的戰士。
description.en: Hold the bowstring patiently to show the arrow that you are a fighter of virtue.

description.zh: 獻給反應敏捷且喜愛連發箭雨的獵人。
description.en: For the hair-trigger hunter who likes firing rapid bursts of arrows.

description.zh: 用削尖的枝條授下花粉，戰利品便是最後的收成。
description.en: Cross-pollinate mobs with sharpened twigs and see what grows from their remains.

description.zh: 四面受敵時的終極利器。
description.en: The ultimate weapon for when you have enemies coming from every direction.

description.zh: 半是樂器卻全然致命；豎琴弩總能奏出正確的樂音。
description.en: Half musical instrument, fully deadly weapon. The Harp Crossbow always hits the right note.

description.zh: 威力較弱的短弓，但射速更快、蓄力更迅速。
description.en: A shorter, weaker bow with a faster fire rate and quicker charge time.

description.zh: 向星辰許願，閃避敵方投射物並加以反擊。
description.en: When you wish upon this star, you will evade enemy projectiles and shoot back.

description.zh: 專為喜歡翻滾、跳躍與射出彈射箭矢的花式射手打造。
description.en: For the trick shooter who likes to roll, jump, and shoot ricocheting arrows.

description.zh: 如幽影般飛掠，化身敵人的惡夢。
description.en: Fly like a phantom and become your enemy’s worst nightmare.

description.zh: 注入伏聆能量的靴子，在伏守者號角幽微的光芒下拼接而成。
description.en: Sculk-infused boots, cobbled by the dim glow of Warden horns.

description.zh: 真正的深淵大師能悄然潛行，直擊敵人要害。
description.en: A true master of the Deep Dark can sneak in and hit their enemy where it hurts.

description.zh: 注入伏聆能量的長袍，在伏守者號角幽微的光芒下織就。
description.en: Sculk-infused robe, woven by the dim glow of Warden horns.

description.zh: 真正的深淵大師能不假思索地閃避與翻身。
description.en: A true master of the Deep Dark can dodge and duck without thinking.

description.zh: 注入伏聆能量的兜帽，在伏守者號角幽微的光芒下裁製。
description.en: Sculk-infused hood, tailored by the dim glow of Warden horns.

description.zh: 真正的深淵大師即使不靠視覺，也能打出暴擊。
description.en: A true master of the Deep Dark doesn’t need their vision to make a critical hit.

description.zh: 注入伏聆能量的護腿，在伏守者號角幽微的光芒下縫製而成。
description.en: Sculk-infused leggings, threaded by the dim glow of Warden horns.

description.zh: 真正的深淵大師，身上只需要陰影……或許再加上一件緊身褲。
description.en: A true master of the Deep Dark doesn’t need to wear anything but shadows... and perhaps a pair of tights.

description.zh: 真正的戰士會穿上隔音的纏足布，讓大地不再顫動。
description.en: A true warrior wears soundproof foot wraps to spare the ground from trembling.

description.zh: 配得上這雙足纏的戰士，出手迅捷有如六角恐龍。
description.en: A warrior worthy of these foot wraps will strike as swiftly as an axolotl.

description.zh: 真正的戰士必須遮住自己的心臟，否則心跳聲會將伏守者喚醒。
description.en: A true warrior must cover their heart, or its beating will wake the Wardens.

description.zh: 真正的賢者，既有勇氣迎戰最強的敵人，也有智慧先從較弱的對手下手。
description.en: A true sage is brave enough to fight the strongest enemy, yet smart enough to start with the weaker ones.

description.zh: 真正的戰士不害怕露出真面目，但仍會遮掩起來，以免驚擾這個世界。
description.en: A true warrior isn't scared to show their face but hides it so as not to scare the world.

description.zh: 配得上這條頭帶的戰士，即使閉上雙眼也能步入箭雨之中。
description.en: A warrior worthy of this headband will walk with their eyes closed into a hail of arrows.

description.zh: 真正的戰士也會穿護腿，畢竟再怎麼勇猛，也需要一點舒適感。
description.en: A true warrior wears leggings. Even warriors need to be comfy.

description.zh: 配得上這條腰帶的戰士，翻滾上百次也不會頭暈。
description.en: A warrior worthy of this belt will roll a hundred times without getting dizzy.

description.zh: 鞋底刻有強大的符文，能防止襪子發臭。
description.en: The soles are etched with powerful runes that stop your socks from stinking.

description.zh: 煉金術士的舊便鞋，厚底層層疊加，靈魂也層層堆疊！
description.en: An alchemist’s old loafers with stacked soles AND stacked with souls!

description.zh: 衣襬縫入了強大的符文，能防止腋下留下汗漬。
description.en: Its hems are stitched with powerful runes that stop your armpits from staining.

description.zh: 煉金術士的舊大衣，能為所有神器賦予額外力量。
description.en: An alchemist’s old overcoat that grants extra power to all artifacts.

description.zh: 帽簷刻有強大的符文，能防止頭皮屑產生。
description.en: Its brim is inscribed with powerful runes that prevent dandruff.

description.zh: 煉金術士的舊高帽，在治療盟友、幫盟友施加護盾時，會投下高聳的陰影。
description.en: An alchemist's old top hat that casts a tall shadow when healing and shielding allies.

description.zh: 縫線注入強大的符文，在彎腰時褲襠也不會裂開。
description.en: The seams are imbued with powerful runes that keep the crotch from ripping when you bend.

description.zh: 煉金術士的舊長褲，讓所有神器都能產生生命值。
description.en: An alchemist’s old trousers that generate health from all artifacts.

description.zh: 柔軟貼身的靴子，融合絲絨的溫暖與鋼鐵的堅韌。
description.en: A snuggly pair of boots, infused with the warmth of wool and the strength of steel.

description.zh: 能在雪地中踏實前行的靴子，獻給從不因畏懼而退縮的戰士。
description.en: A pair of snow-plodding boots for the warrior who never gets cold feet.

description.zh: 舒適的毛衣，融合絲絨的溫暖與鋼鐵的堅韌。
description.en: A cozy sweater, infused with the warmth of wool and the strength of steel.

description.zh: 為忠誠的盟友打造的霜鑄護甲，從不對朋友冷眼以對。
description.en: Frost-forged armor for the loyal ally who never gives friends the cold shoulder.

description.zh: 舒適的帽子，融合羊毛的溫暖與鋼鐵的堅韌。
description.en: A comfy cap, infused with the warmth of wool and the strength of steel.

description.zh: 冰冷的帽子，讓你在危險時刻也能保持冷靜。
description.en: An ice-cold cap to keep your head cool in dangerous situations.

description.zh: 溫暖舒適的護腿，融合羊毛的溫暖與鋼鐵的堅韌。
description.en: A toasty pair of leggings, infused with the warmth of wool and the strength of steel.

description.zh: 清爽透氣的衛生褲，讓你在衝入敵群時依然能保持冷靜。
description.en: A pair of breezy longjohns for keeping chill when running into enemy hordes.

description.zh: 獻給熱愛在林間漫步的旅人。
description.en: For the traveler who loves walking in the woods.

description.zh: 根鬚纏繞的靴子，讓你腳踏實地，並不斷產生可用來製箭的枝條。
description.en: A pair of root boots to keep you grounded with endlessly springing twigs to fletch into arrows.

description.zh: 你的敵人很快就會發現他們惹錯了人。
description.en: Your enemies will soon realize they’re barking up the wrong tree.

description.zh: 這件樹皮胸甲已注入著森林的自然療癒之力。
description.en: This bark chestplate is imbued with the natural healing properties of the forest.

description.zh: 如果你見樹不見林，那多半是戴反了。
description.en: If you can’t see the forest for the trees, you’re probably wearing it the wrong way.

description.zh: 深色的橡木面具，頂戴附魔花冠，能為你的寵物提供自然抗性。
description.en: A dark oak mask crowned with enchanted flowers that grant natural resistance to your pets.

description.zh: 當你需要像樹葉一樣落地而無聲時。
description.en: For when you need to make like a tree and leave.

description.zh: 荊棘佈滿的樹幹護腿，受攻擊時能以尖刺反擊。
description.en: A pair of thorned treetrunk leggings for prickly kicking back when under attack.

description.zh: 讓你的步伐帶著嗡鳴，踢擊時多一分刺痛。
description.en: Adds a buzz to your step and a sting to your kicks.

description.zh: 以魔法蜂蠟潤滑過的靴子，讓你的神器運作有如蜂蜜般滑順。
description.en: Boots greased with magical beeswax to make your artifacts run as smooth as honey.

description.zh: 在你伸手奪取金色珍寶時，為你抵擋蜂群的侵襲。
description.en: Shields you from the swarms as you reach for their golden treasures.

description.zh: 以魔法蜂蜜鍛造的胸甲，能為整個蜂巢帶來療癒。
description.en: A chestplate forged with magical honey for healing your whole hive.

description.zh: 不遮擋視線，也能讓敵人無法靠近你的臉部。
description.en: Keeps enemies out of your face without compromising your vision.

description.zh: 注入了魔法蜂蠟的硬帽，能讓正面狀態像蜂蜜一樣緊緊附著。
description.en: A hardhat imbued with magical beeswax to make positive statuses stick like honey.

description.zh: 就護腿而言，這雙真的稱得上是極品中的極品。
description.en: As far as leggings go, these truly are the bee’s knees.

description.zh: 塗覆魔法蜂蜜的長褲，可加快從疾病與枯萎效果中復原的速度。
description.en: Trousers coated with magical honey for quicker recovery from diseases and blights.

description.zh: 最適合經典而老派的地下城探險，以及傭兵式的惡作劇。
description.en: For some good, old-fashioned dungeon running and mercenary mischief.

description.zh: 經典的鑽石靴子，硬到能用腳擋下攻擊。
description.en: A pair of classic diamond boots so hard you can block attacks with your feet.

description.zh: 保護心臟，不讓任何人輕易靠近。
description.en: Protects your heart from anyone trying to get too close.

description.zh: 經典的鑽石胸甲，最適合出手凌厲、刀鋒銳利的戰士。
description.en: A classic diamond chestplate for the warrior with a hard punch and a sharp blade.

description.zh: 與拯救世界的沉重使命相比，這頂頭盔輕多了。
description.en: Weighs less than the heavy burden of saving the world.

description.zh: 經典鑽石頭盔，最適合兼具戰鬥狠勁與採礦巧手的戰士。
description.en: A classic diamond helmet for the fighter with a head for both maiming and mining.

description.zh: 傭兵不向任何人屈膝，尤其是穿上這對護脛後，是真的跪不下去。
description.en: A mercenary bends the knee to no one. And in these shinguards, it’s literally impossible.

description.zh: 經典的鑽石護腿，能將你從尚待雕琢的璞玉，鍛造成閃耀奪目的寶石。
description.en: A pair of classic diamond leggings that will mold you from a diamond in the rough into a shining jewel.

description.zh: 這雙靴子不建議食用。不然可能會發生詭異行為且雙腳發冷。
description.en: Eating the boots is not advised. Side effects may include suspicious behavior and cold feet.

description.zh: 只要讓寵物夥伴啃一小口，這雙雨靴就能賦予牠們自然抗性。
description.en: Give your pet companions a nibble of these galoshes and it will grant them natural resistance.

description.zh: 這件長袍不建議食用。不然可能會發生詭異行為且肩膀發冷。
description.en: Eating the robe is not advised. Side effects may include suspicious behavior and cold shoulders.

description.zh: 以菌絲製成的可愛外套，具備自然療癒的效果。
description.en: A cute coat made of mycelium with natural healing properties.

description.zh: 這頂帽子不建議食用。不然可能會發生詭異行為且耳朵發冷。
description.en: Eating the cap is not advised. Side effects may include suspicious behavior and cold ears.

description.zh: 附魔的蘑菇帽，能讓拳擊帶毒，令人聞之色變。
description.en: An enchanted mushroom cap for poisoned punches and toxic terror.

description.zh: 這件護腿不建議食用。不然可能會發生詭異行為且大腿發冷。
description.en: Eating the leggings is not advised. Side effects may include suspicious behavior and cold thighs.

description.zh: 別吃這件長褲！這對人類有毒，但能為你的寵物賦予額外力量。
description.en: Don’t eat the trousers! They are poisonous to humans but grant extra strength to your pets.

description.zh: 將喚魔者的靴子重新利用，加上鐵製靴頭，專門用來痛擊壞村民。
description.en: An Evoker's boots repurposed for kicking Illager butt with an iron toe to boot.

description.zh: 一雙附魔涼鞋，引領你的雙腳走向最佳獎勵。
description.en: A pair of enchanted sandals that guide your feet to the best rewards.

description.zh: 將喚魔者的長袍重新裁製而成，獻給更英俊出眾的穿戴者。
description.en: An Evoker's robe retailored to suit a far more handsome wearer.

description.zh: 遭到污染的披風，能讓敵人吃足苦頭，也能讓你變得更加好看。
description.en: A tainted mantle that leaves your enemies worse for wear but looks great on you.

description.zh: 魔術師的頭環，上面鑲嵌著從破碎傳送門後搜到的黑曜石。
description.en: A Magician’s circlet with an obsidian stone scavenged from a broken portal.

description.zh: 在雷雨中鍛造而成的耀眼王冠，獻給思維敏捷的戰士。
description.en: A striking crown forged in a thunderstorm for a fighter with bright ideas.

description.zh: 自喚魔者的護腿重新改造而得，為英雄所用，但不確定有沒有洗過！
description.en: An Evoker’s leggings repurposed for a hero. Let’s hope somebody washed them first!

description.zh: 柔韌貼身的緊身褲，方便快速取用神器。
description.en: A pair of flexible tights for fast access to artifacts.

description.zh: 皮革長靴，在某個徹夜未眠的夜晚裡打造而成。
description.en: Leather boots crafted during a sleepless night long ago.

description.zh: 極為舒適的拖鞋，讓你直接從床上滾下來就能衝進戰場！
description.en: A pair of slippers so cozy you’ll roll out of bed and jump into battle!

description.zh: 強化胸甲，在某個徹夜未眠的夜晚裡鍛造而成。
description.en: Reinforced chestplate forged during a sleepless night long ago.

description.zh: 如同被褥般舒適的胸甲，幫助你專注鎖定目標。
description.en: A chestplate as comfy as a bedcover, helping you focus on your targets.

description.zh: 堅固的頭盔，在某個徹夜未眠的夜晚裡鍛造而成。
description.en: Sturdy helmet forged during a sleepless night long ago.

description.zh: 如枕頭般柔軟的王冠，帶來靜謐的靈魂蒐集之夢。
description.en: A crown as soft as a pillow for tranquil dreams of soul gathering.

description.zh: 耐用長褲，在某個徹夜未眠的夜晚裡縫製而成。
description.en: Durable pants threaded during a sleepless night long ago.

description.zh: 如同影子般輕盈的睡褲，助你潛入敵人的惡夢之中。
description.en: A pair of pyjama pants as light as shadows, helping you sneak through your enemy’s nightmares.

description.zh: 用來追蹤野生獵物或毫無防備的敵人。
description.en: For tracking down wild prey or unsuspecting enemies.

description.zh: 帶有馬刺的鞋子，腳踝處留有空間可攜帶更多箭矢。
description.en: A pair of spurred shoes with ankle space for extra arrows.

description.zh: 遊俠的外套，無論近看還是遠觀都必須帥氣十足。
description.en: A ranger’s jacket must look cool both at close range and at a distance.

description.zh: 看起來美味可口的長外套，搭配穩定臂部的護具，讓遠程攻擊更具威力。
description.en: A delicious-looking duster with stabilizing arm guards for powerful ranged attacks.

description.zh: 瞄準就是關鍵。那次一箭雙殺雞騎士，就是你最值得誇耀的戰績。
description.en: Aim is the name of the game. That chicken jockey double-shot is the feather in your cap.

description.zh: 華麗的軟呢帽，附帶單眼瞄準鏡，可同時鎖定多支箭矢的目標。
description.en: A flashy fedora with an attached monocle scope for aiming multiple arrows at once.

description.zh: 舒適的護腿，能讓你坐等好幾天，只為那完美的一擊。
description.en: You could sit in these comfy leggings for days, just waiting for the perfect shot.

description.zh: 銳利的皮革護褲，適合穿著在野外製作箭矢。
description.en: A pair of sharp leather chaps for fletching arrows in the wild.

description.zh: 用紅石巨獸的殘骸碎石拼製而成。
description.en: Cobbled from the rubble of a Redstone Monstrosity.

description.zh: 怪物般的靴子，能讓你一腳踢起漫天的紅石粉塵。
description.en: A pair of monstrous boots for when you need to kick up some redstone dust.

description.zh: 你的勝利早已刻在紅石之中。
description.en: Your victory is already set in redstone.

description.zh: 怪物般的胸甲，能透過巧妙的紅石迴路，將你的心臟與神器連結一起。
description.en: A monstrous chestplate that links your heart to your artifacts via ingenious redstone circuits.

description.zh: 以紅石巨獸的頭骨打造而成。
description.en: Crafted from the skull of a Redstone Monstrosity.

description.zh: 怪物般的面具，最適合脾氣火爆且意志堅定的戰士。
description.en: A monstrous mask for the hardheaded warrior with a fiery temper.

description.zh: 一石二鳥，也就是一顆紅石打中二隻鳥。
description.en: For kicking two birds with one redstone.

description.zh: 怪物般地護脛，保護你的膝蓋不受到各種侵害。
description.en: A pair of monstrous greaves that protect your knees from the elements.

description.zh: 適合用來悄悄接近敵人，順便奪走他們的戰利品。
description.en: For sneaking up on enemies and taking their loot.

description.zh: 滑溜的潛行鞋，讓你以輕盈步伐潛行於陰影之中。
description.en: A pair of slick sneakers that let you prowl through the shadows on light feet.

description.zh: 袖子裡藏有額外的空間，讓你隨時都有花招能出。
description.en: Holds extra space for keeping tricks up your sleeves.

description.zh: 大膽張揚的西裝外套，搭配穩定肩部的設計，適合近距離射擊。
description.en: A bold blazer with stabilized shoulders for close-range archery.

description.zh: 適合用來融入黑暗角落，悄然穿梭於夜色之中。
description.en: For blending into dark corners and sneaking through the night.

description.zh: 注入暗影之力而殺氣十足的兜帽，讓你更容易接近敵人。
description.en: A killer-looking cowl infused with shadows for sneaking up on enemies.

description.zh: 最適合拔腿就跑。
description.en: For when you need to leg it fast.

description.zh: 致命的護腿，配備大腿護甲，專為單手裝填而設計。
description.en: A pair of lethal leggings with thigh guards designed for one-handed reloads.

description.zh: 這雙靴子悄悄穿越了隙浮的無數次潮汐，久遠到你難以想像。
description.en: These boots have sculked across the Sift for more tides than you can imagine.

description.zh: 帶著利爪的尊貴長靴，讓你在各個維度都能站立在生態鏈的頂端。
description.en: A pair of regal boots with sharp talons. Be the top of the ecosystem in every dimension.

description.zh: 氣勢兇悍的長袍，和伏聆者的皮一樣堅韌。
description.en: A ferocious robe as durable as sculker hide.

description.zh: 配得上君主之名的華麗披風，對各種環境具備額外抗性。
description.en: A majestic mantle worthy of a Monarch, with extra resilience against the elements.

description.zh: 透過伏聆者的雙眼觀看世界，只要忽略耳邊的靈魂哀號即可。
description.en: See through the eyes of a Sculker, just ignore the sound of souls howling in your ears.

description.zh: 由靈漿硬殼構成的王冠，讓敵人甘願把戰利品奉到你腳下。
description.en: A worthy crown of ichor crust that will have your enemies throw gifts at your feet.

description.zh: 別偷懶了，一起來潛伏與聆聽吧！
description.en: Don't slack around. Get busy sculking!

description.zh: 以君主羽飾製成的高貴腰帶，還額外留有空間用來囤積靈魂。
description.en: A noble sash made from Monarch plume, with extra space for hoarding souls.

description.zh: 一雙舞鞋，讓你隨著只有自己能聽見的音樂起舞。
description.en: A pair of dancing shoes for moving to music only you can hear.

description.zh: 塗覆靈漿的神祕涼鞋。……沒有在聽。
description.en: A mysterious pair of sandals greased with ichor. ...aren’t listening.

description.zh: 當你與死亡共舞，隙浮中的靈魂也會一同起舞。
description.en: When you dance with death, the souls of the Sift dance with you.

description.zh: 令人不寒而慄的斗篷，上面塗著靈漿。……聽聽那些……
description.en: A haunting cloak coated with ichor. ...hear the...

description.zh: 帶有破損面紗的兜帽，當危險逼近時，會隨著微風輕輕擺動。
description.en: Hood with a tattered veil that sways in the breeze whenever danger is close.

description.zh: 以靈漿編織而成、難以捉摸的面紗。如果你無法……
description.en: An elusive veil weaved with ichor. If you can’t...

description.zh: 富有彈性的護腿，讓你能與敵人共舞。
description.en: A pair of stretchy leggings for dancing with the enemy.

description.zh: 氣息詭譎的馬褲，裡面注入了靈漿。……低語著，你……
description.en: An eerie pair of breeches infused with ichor. ...whispers, you...

description.zh: 世代相傳，用來守護獲選的守護者。責任重大！
description.en: Passed down for generations to serve a chosen protector. Big shoes to fill!

description.zh: 這雙長靴既能迅速閃避攻擊，又如同轟鳴蟲殼骸般堅硬。
description.en: These boots are quick to dodge attacks, yet as hard as the humbler husk they were made from.

description.zh: 世代相傳，用來守護獲選的守護者。沉重的使命！
description.en: Passed down for generations to serve a chosen protector. A heavy burden!

description.zh: 一件胸甲，蘊含轟鳴蟲殼骸的療癒屬性。
description.en: A carapace chestplate imbued with the healing properties of humbler husk.

description.zh: 世代相傳，用來守護獲選的守護者。別沖昏頭了。
description.en: Passed down for generations to serve a chosen protector. Don't let it get to your head.

description.zh: 堅不可摧的頭盔，堅固程度有如用來打造它的轟鳴蟲殼骸。
description.en: A helmet almost as impenetrable as the humbler husk it was made from.

description.zh: 一旦穿上，雙腿絕不會發軟。
description.en: Your legs won’t turn to jelly wearing these.

description.zh: 柔韌的轟鳴蟲殼骸護脛，讓你的攻擊距離更遠。
description.en: A pair of flexible humbler husk greaves that give extra reach to your attacks.

description.zh: 以新維度中才有的彈跳方塊打造而成的美味長靴。
description.en: A pair of delicious boots crafted from bouncy blocks only found in the new dimension.

description.zh: 腐化靈魂的涼鞋，能引導箭矢命中目標。
description.en: A pair of Soul Corrupted sandals that help guide your arrows to their targets.

description.zh: 光彩奪目的長袍，以僅存在於新維度的堅韌素材鍛造而成。
description.en: A dazzling robe forged from sturdy stuff only found in the new dimension.

description.zh: 腐化靈魂的長外套，寬大的衣袖能讓再生之泉與護盾的作用範圍更加廣。
description.en: A Soul Corrupted duster with long arms for wider-reaching Regeneration wells and shields.

description.zh: 華麗的帽子，以僅存在於新維度的黏稠材質製成。
description.en: A fancy hat made from sticky substances only found in the new dimension.

description.zh: 腐化靈魂的面具，讓弓拉得越久，箭矢的威力就越強。
description.en: A Soul Corrupted mask that charges your arrows the longer you pull.

description.zh: 質地豐厚的護腿，以僅存在於新維度的濕潤素材編織而成。
description.en: A pair of lush leggings woven from moist materials only found in the new dimension.

description.zh: 腐化靈魂的腰帶，能為箭矢賦予額外的衝擊力。
description.en: A Soul Corrupted sash that grants extra force to your arrows.

description.zh: 以暗色金屬與骨骼打造，最適合意志堅定的賞金獵人。
description.en: Made from dark metal and bone, fit for the unwavering bounty hunter.

description.zh: 獻給滿腔熱血且無所畏懼，卻渴求著更多靈魂的戰士。
description.en: For the dauntless warrior who has a lot of heart but needs a lot of souls.

description.zh: 以暗色金屬與骨骼打造，最適合不知疲倦的賞金獵人。
description.en: Made from dark metal and bone, fit for the tireless bounty hunter.

description.zh: 獻給無所畏懼而敢於直面箭雨的戰士。
description.en: For the dauntless warrior who isn’t afraid to face a hail of arrows.

description.zh: 以暗色金屬與骨骼打造，最適合堅韌不拔的賞金獵人。
description.en: Made from dark metal and bone, fit for the enduring bounty hunter.

description.zh: 戴上這頂角盔，衝撞敵人，讓他們吃點苦頭。
description.en: Ram into your enemies with this horned helmet to knock them down a peg.

description.zh: 以暗色金屬與骨骼打造，最適合窮追不捨的賞金獵人。
description.en: Made from dark metal and bone, fit for the relentless bounty hunter.

description.zh: 獻給無所畏懼而勇於站上前線的戰士。
description.en: For the dauntless warrior who isn’t scared to stand on the frontline.

description.zh: 可靠的靴子，能陪你在主世界中踏遍四方，尋找冒險。
description.en: A pair of reliable boots for traversing the Overworld in search of adventure.

description.zh: 耐用的鐵製戰靴，讓你在危險之中也能隨時保持警覺。
description.en: A pair of durable iron boots that keep you on your toes when in danger.

description.zh: 堅固的胸甲，能陪你在主世界中遊走四方，追尋正義。
description.en: A sturdy chestplate for roaming the Overworld in search of justice.

description.zh: 配有厚實護肩的防護胸甲，可用來抵禦遠程攻擊。
description.en: A protective chestplate with thick pauldrons to deflect ranged attacks.

description.zh: 防雨兜帽，能陪你在主世界中四處徘徊，尋找危險。
description.en: A rainproof hood for wandering the Overworld in search of danger.

description.zh: 配備了強化面罩的可靠頭盔，能帶來暴擊的精準度。
description.en: A reliable helmet with an enhanced visor for critical precision.

description.zh: 耐用的護腿，能陪你在主世界中長途跋涉，尋找自身的使命。
description.en: A pair of durable leggings for trekking the Overworld in search of purpose.

description.zh: 靈活的鐵製綁腿，能帶來額外的攻擊動能。
description.en: A pair of limber iron gaiters for extra attack momentum.

description.zh: 柔軟的靴子，讓你能迅速奔回巢穴，警告同伴有掠食者來襲。
description.en: Soft boots for running home to warn your nest of predators.

description.zh: 模仿隙浮特前爪而製成的靴子，同樣能迅速偏轉遠程攻擊。
description.en: A pair of boots fashioned like Sifter paws, just as quick to deflect ranged attacks.

description.zh: 在守護巢穴、抵禦掠食者時，也要看起來光彩奪目。
description.en: For looking fabulous as you defend your nest against predators.

description.zh: 模仿暴怒隙浮特而製成的附魔背心，能為所有神器賦予盛怒之力。
description.en: An enchanted vest fashioned like an enraged Sifter that grants enraged power to all artifacts.

description.zh: 一頂可愛的兜帽，附有討喜的耳朵，用來傾聽潛行中的掠食者。
description.en: A cute hood with adorable ears to listen for sculking predators.

description.zh: 模仿盛暴怒浮特而製成的污染面具，足以讓敵人心生畏懼。
description.en: A tainted mask fashioned like an enraged Sifter, designed to scare your enemies to their core.

description.zh: 幫助你在新維度無情的潮汐中存活下來。
description.en: These will help you survive the unforgiving tides of the new dimension.

description.zh: 模仿隙浮特雙腿而製成的長褲，注入了強化過的力量。
description.en: A pair of slacks fashioned like Sifter legs, imbued with boosting powers.

description.zh: 來自狼群的敬意獻禮，讓你能在午夜時分與牠們一同奔跑。
description.en: A respectful offering from your wolf pack so you can run with them at midnight.

description.zh: 覆有狼毛且帶著銳利爪刃的靴子，非常適合用來製作更多箭矢。
description.en: A pair of wolf fur boots with razor-sharp claws, perfect for fletching extra arrows.

description.zh: 來自狼群的敬意獻禮，讓你在寒冷的夜裡保持溫暖。
description.en: A respectful offering from your wolf pack to keep warm in the cold of night.

description.zh: 以真心領導，讓狼群明白自己是為誰而戰。
description.en: Lead with your heart and show your pack who they are fighting for.

description.zh: 來自狼群的敬意獻禮，讓你能加入牠們夜晚的長嚎。
description.en: A respectful offering from your wolf pack so you can join their howling at night.

description.zh: 透過狼的雙眼看世界，能在遠距離發現敵人。
description.en: See through the eyes of a wolf and spot enemies at far distances.

description.zh: 來自狼群的敬意獻禮，讓你能在滿月下追逐自己的尾巴。
description.en: A respectful offering from your wolf pack so you can chase your tail under the full moon.

description.zh: 覆有魔法印記的毛皮護腿，能引導狼群回到你身邊。
description.en: A pair of leggings of magically imprinted fur that guide your pack back to your side.

description.zh: 能吸引敵人注意，好讓你脫身或發動伏擊。假人擁有自己的生命值，但卻沒有和你一樣的魅力。
description.en: Draws the attention of enemies as you escape or ambush. The dummy has its own pool of health, but none of your charisma.

description.zh: 透過靈魂的能量，向敵人釋放暴風雪，並創造出溫馨的冬日仙境。
description.en: Blasts a soul-powered blizzard at your enemies and creates a cozy winter wonderland.

description.zh: 你的六角恐龍伴會攻擊任何試圖傷害你的人。致命又可愛！
description.en: Your axolotl friend will attack anyone who tries to harm you. Deadly AND adorable!

description.zh: 射出狡猾又美味的投射物，命中後會分裂成多片蛋糕，造成額外的「蛋糕爆裂」傷害。生日快樂啦，倒楣鬼！
description.en: Shoots a deviously delicious projectile that splits into multiple slices for additional cake-splosive damage. Happy birthday, suckers!

description.zh: 這具鏤空殼骸所奏出的樂聲可抵禦遠距攻擊。
description.en: The music of this hollowed husk protects against ranged attacks.

description.zh: 能為攻擊注入劈啪作響的電能，而且戴在手腕上也相當搶眼！
description.en: Imbues your attacks with the power of crackling electricity and looks striking on your wrist!

description.zh: 將靈魂轉化成純粹的力量，可短時間連續發射，或釋放一次能汲取靈魂的終極攻擊。
description.en: Turns souls into raw power as you fire it in short bursts or in one long, soul-draining blast of ultimate power.

description.zh: 瞬間催生致命的藤蔓，使敵人中毒並受到束縛，而你則能收割親手種下的果實。
description.en: Instantly sprout into deadly vines, poisoning and binding your enemies while you reap what you’ve sown.

description.zh: 看起來是再普通不過的蠟燭，但燃燒的燭芯卻傳來不祥的嘶嘶聲響……等等，那是引信！
description.en: Just a completely normal candle, apart from that ominous hss coming from the burning wick... Wait, that’s a fuse!

description.zh: 勇敢的戰士會在戰鬥前食用，進入狂暴狀態，同時提升移動與攻擊的速度。
description.en: Eaten by daring warriors before battle to enter a berserker state, increasing both movement and attack speed.

description.zh: 這個喇叭發出的聲音非常刺耳，連敵人都受不了而窩裡反。
description.en: The sound of this honking horn is so annoying that your enemies will start fighting each other instead.

description.zh: 長笛的樂音能賦予出色的戰士更強的攻擊能力。
description.en: The music of the flute grants critical striking powers to any fighter of note.

description.zh: 能為攻擊注入熾烈火焰的力量，而且戴在手腕上也格外耀眼！
description.en: Imbues your attacks with the power of a blazing inferno and looks radiant on your wrist!

description.zh: 炸藥的爆炸威力加上箭矢的速度，怎麼可能會出錯？
description.en: The explosive power of the TNT combined with the high velocity movement of an arrow, what could possibly go wrong?

description.zh: 以正義怒火的火焰點燃你的箭矢。
description.en: Light your arrows with the flame of your righteous rage.

description.zh: 手持權杖注入靈魂能量，接著釋放靈魂之火焚燒敵人。
description.en: Hold the scepter to charge it up with souls, then release soul-powered fire on your enemies.

description.zh: 能為攻擊注入冰霜暴雪的力量，而且戴在手腕上也酷勁十足！
description.en: Imbues your attacks with the power of freezing blizzards and looks really cool on your wrist!

description.zh: 這些箭矢會讓敵人因恐懼與寒冷而顫抖。
description.en: These arrows will have your enemies quivering from both fear and cold.

description.zh: 用砂輪來研磨武器，讓敵人感受到鋼鐵般的刺痛，造成額外傷害。
description.en: Sharpen your weapons on the grindstone to make enemies feel the sting of your steel and cause extra damage.

description.zh: 勇敢的戰士會在戰鬥前食用來提升移動速度，隨即衝鋒上陣。
description.en: Eaten by daring warriors before battle, sending them charging into battle with increased movement speed.

description.zh: 黏答答的美味點心，可用來困住敵人，同時讓嗡嗡作響的夥伴加入戰局！勝利從來不曾這麼甜蜜。
description.en: A sticky treat to trap your enemies as your buzzing friends join the battle! Victory never tasted so sweet.

description.zh: 這把精緻的樂器以龜仙藥水作為塗層，只要跟上節奏，就能為朋友們賦予抗性。
description.en: A beautiful instrument varnished with Potion of the Turtle Master, granting resistance to all friends who catch your groove.

description.zh: 這些箭矢將如天雷般擊中敵人。
description.en: These arrows will strike your enemies like lightning from the skies.

description.zh: 引導著靈魂能量的雷電。只要持續使用，就能把敵人電到暈頭轉向。
description.en: Channels soul-powered lightning, zapping your enemies silly for as long as you hold it.

description.zh: 勇敢的戰士會在戰鬥前食用，釋放怒火，以提升攻擊速度。
description.en: Eaten by daring warriors before battle, unleashing their rage and increasing their attack speed.

description.zh: 今天真是野餐的好日子！與朋友們分享健康的點心。餓著肚子是沒辦法共赴戰場的。
description.en: Great day for a picnic! Share healthy treats with your friends. Hangry friends make for bad allies in battle.

description.zh: 能為攻擊注入劇毒力量，而且戴在手腕上也同樣耀眼！
description.en: Imbues your attacks with poisonous power and looks stunning on your wrist!

description.zh: 這個箭袋浸滿毒液，讓箭矢命中時多一分狠勁。
description.en: A quiver soaked in venom for that extra sting when your arrows bite.

description.zh: 來點震撼吧！巨力沙錘樂趣十足，一擊就能把敵人震到腦袋發麻！
description.en: Let’s shake things up! The Powershaker is a smashing good time and will blow your enemies’ minds!

description.zh: 這支神祕號角的樂音會將敵人震飛，耳鳴不止。但可能需要多加練習。
description.en: The music from this mystical horn will knock enemies over and leave their ears ringing. You may need some practice.

description.zh: 這款是最先進的地雷發射器，能一次射出一整排的爆炸性紅石地雷。
description.en: This state-of-the-craft mine launcher will fire a volley of explosive Redstone mines.

description.zh: 丟到地面即可在身邊擴散混亂的電能。電力十足！
description.en: Throw it on the ground to spread conductive chaos around yourself. It’s a real power trip!

description.zh: 丟到地面即可在身邊引燃猛烈火焰，熱到讓人不敢靠近！
description.en: Throw it on the ground to spread a fierce fire around yourself. You’ll be too hot to handle!

description.zh: 丟到地面即可在身邊捲起刺骨暴雪。絕對是最酷的神器之一！
description.en: Throw it on the ground to spread a blistering blizzard around yourself. One of the coolest artifacts there is!

description.zh: 丟到地面即可在身邊擴散致命毒氣。放心，這款驅怪道具完全環保。
description.en: Throw it on the ground to spread toxic terror around yourself. Don’t worry, this mob repellent is completely eco-friendly.

description.zh: 終界迷霧彈能讓你隱身於陰影之中，悄悄接近敵人。
description.en: The Ender Fog smoke bomb lets you sneak up on enemies, cloaked by shadows.

description.zh: 先以收集到的靈魂為其充能，再一次釋放成團的強力詛咒。
description.en: Charge it up with the souls you have collected before releasing them into a cluster hex of power.

description.zh: 能在戰場上旋轉飛掠，切割行進路徑上的敵人；聽雇主交辦任務時，還能用來把玩舒壓。
description.en: Spins across the battlefield, slicing enemies in its path. Also, a fun fidget toy while waiting for quest givers to finish talking.

description.zh: 將圖騰放置在地面，即可為盟友擴散巧工能量，縮短神器冷卻時間。
description.en: Place the totem on the ground to spread artificing energy to your allies, reducing their artifact cooldown time.

description.zh: 這尊木製人偶散發出營火般的溫暖氣息，能治療聚集在周圍的所有夥伴。
description.en: This wooden figurine radiates a warmth like that of a crackling campfire and heals all friends who gather around it.

description.zh: 這座純金圖騰會展開防護屏障，為其中的所有人抵禦投射物攻擊。
description.en: This solid gold totem radiates a protective barrier, shielding all inside it from projectiles.

description.zh: 手持這支劇毒手杖並注入靈魂能量，接著釋放由靈魂所驅動的毒氣來攻擊敵人。
description.en: Hold this Toxic Cane to charge it up with souls, then release the soul powered poison gas on your enemies.

description.zh: 升起戰爭旗幟，為你與附近的所有盟友賦予力量。
description.en: Raise the banner of war and grant strength to you and all nearby allies.

description.zh: 以轟鳴蟲殼骸製成的風鈴。其樂聲會讓你的皮膚變得像甲殼一樣厚實。
description.en: Chimes crafted from humbler husk. Their music turns your skin as thick as carapace.

description.zh: 讓戰鼓聲震撼戰士之心，使所有暴擊造成雙倍傷害。
description.en: Let the sound of drums fill your warrior heart with the power to do double damage on all critical hits.

description.zh: 女巫的祕密配方，擲向敵人後會擴散煙霧並削弱敵人。裡面到底加了什麼呢？
description.en: A witch's secret formula to throw at your enemies and spread a cloud of weakening vapor. What do they put in this stuff?

description.zh: 使用神器後，會縮短神器冷卻時間並提升傷害，持續 {數值} 秒。
description.en: Artifact usage improves artifact cooldown and damage for {value} seconds.

descriptionLong.zh: 使用神器會獲得「巧工」狀態，縮短神器冷卻時間，同時提高神器傷害與靈魂收集量。
descriptionLong.en: Using an artifact grants the Artificing status, decreasing artifact cooldown while increasing artifact damage and soul gathering.

description.zh: 敵人遭夥伴擊敗時，有 {數值} 的機率爆炸。
description.en: {value} chance of enemies exploding when defeated by companions.

descriptionLong.zh: 一種附魔效果，能賦予夥伴爆炸魔法力量。
descriptionLong.en: An enchantment that grants companions explosive magical powers.

description.zh: 跳躍攻擊落地時會額外造成 {數值} 點傷害，並使擊退效果提高 {數值}。
description.en: Jump attack landings deal {value} additional damage and increases knockback by {value}.

descriptionLong.zh: 跳躍攻擊會造成衝擊，對附近敵人造成額外傷害並擊退敵人。
descriptionLong.en: Jump attacks cause an impact that deals additional damage to nearby enemies and knocks them back.

description.zh: 武器攻擊會部署 {數值} 枚地雷，在敵人接近時或經過一小段時間後爆炸。
description.en: Weapon attacks deploy {value} mines that explode in proximity to enemies or after a short time.

descriptionLong.zh: 武器攻擊會部署終界水晶，在敵人接近時或經過一小段時間後爆炸。
descriptionLong.en: Weapon attacks deploy End crystals that explode in proximity to enemies or after a short time.

description.zh: 翻滾會連續射出 {數值} 支箭矢，造成相當於遠程武器傷害 {數值} 的傷害。
description.en: Rolling fires a barrage of {value} arrows, dealing {value} of ranged weapon damage.

descriptionLong.zh: 翻滾會連續向附近敵人射出一陣箭雨。
descriptionLong.en: Rolling fires a barrage of arrows targeting nearby enemies.

description.zh: 投射物有 {數值} 的機率額外生成 {數值} 枚投射物。
description.en: Projectiles have a {value} chance to spawn {value} additional projectiles.

descriptionLong.zh: 遠程攻擊命中時，有機率向附近敵人射出額外投射物。
descriptionLong.en: Successful ranged hits have a chance to fire off additional projectiles at nearby enemies.

description.zh: 波動會造成相當於武器傷害 {數值} 的傷害，並短暫電擊生物，使其變弱但速度變快。
description.en: Wave deals {value} of weapon damage and zaps mobs for a short time, making them weaker but faster.

descriptionLong.zh: 跳躍攻擊與終結攻擊會產生閃電波動，傷害敵人並短暫電擊敵人，使其變弱但速度變快。
descriptionLong.en: Jump attacks and final hits create a wave of lightning that damages enemies and zaps them for a short time, making them weaker but faster.

description.zh: 攻擊敵人時，有 {數值} 的機率進入潛影狀態。
description.en: Grants a {value} chance to enter Shadowcloaking when attacking enemies.

descriptionLong.zh: 一種附魔效果，能在攻擊時進入潛影狀態。
descriptionLong.en: An enchantment that grants the ability to enter a state of shadowcloaking while attacking.

description.zh: 暴擊會使下一次攻擊的暴擊機率提高 {數值}。
description.en: Critical hits increase critical hit chance of the next attack by {value}.

descriptionLong.zh: 一種附魔效果，能在連續暴擊時提升暴擊準度。
descriptionLong.en: An enchantment that improves critical aim for each critical hit made in a row.

description.zh: 暴擊會回復 {數值} 支箭矢。
description.en: Critical hits restore {value} arrows.

descriptionLong.zh: 暴擊會將箭矢回復至箭袋中。
descriptionLong.en: Critical hits restore arrows to your quiver.

description.zh: 翻滾會讓你的下一次近戰或遠程攻擊獲得 {數值} 傷害增幅。
description.en: Rolling applies {value} damage amplification to your next melee or ranged attack.

descriptionLong.zh: 翻滾會提高你的下一次近戰或遠程攻擊傷害，每次使用時效果都會堆疊。
descriptionLong.en: Rolling amplifies the damage of your next melee or ranged attack, stacking with each use.

description.zh: 獲得 {數值} 支額外箭矢。
description.en: Grants {value} additional arrows.

descriptionLong.zh: 提高你的箭矢容量上限。
descriptionLong.en: Increases your maximum arrow capacity.

description.zh: 波動會造成相當於武器傷害 {數值} 的傷害，並讓生物短暫著火。
description.en: Wave deals {value} of weapon damage and sets mobs on fire for a short time.

descriptionLong.zh: 跳躍攻擊與終結攻擊會產生火焰波動，傷害敵人並使其短暫著火。
descriptionLong.en: Jump attacks and final hits create a wave of fire that damages enemies and sets them on fire for a short time.

description.zh: 波動會造成相當於武器傷害 {數值} 的傷害，並讓生物短暫著火。
description.en: Wave deals {value} of weapon damage and sets mobs on fire for a short time.

descriptionLong.zh: 一種附魔效果，能在戰鬥中使武器燃起火焰。
descriptionLong.en: An enchantment that sets a weapon on fire during combat.

description.zh: 波動會造成相當於武器傷害 {數值} 的傷害，並短暫凍結生物，使其攻擊與移動速度降低。
description.en: Wave deals {value} of weapon damage and freezes mobs for a short time, slowing their attacks and movement.

descriptionLong.zh: 跳躍攻擊與終結攻擊會產生冰霜波動，傷害敵人並短暫凍結敵人，使其攻擊與移動速度降低。
descriptionLong.en: Jump attacks and final hits create a wave of ice that damages enemies and freezes them for a short time, slowing their attacks and movement.

description.zh: 使用神器時，會將 {數值} 格內的所有敵人拉向你。
description.en: Artifact usage pulls all enemies within {value} blocks toward you.

descriptionLong.zh: 使用神器時，會將附近所有敵人拉向你。
descriptionLong.en: Using an artifact pulls all nearby enemies toward you.

description.zh: 攻擊有機率將 {數值} 格內的所有敵人拉向你。
description.en: Attacks have a chance to pull all enemies within {value} blocks toward you.

descriptionLong.zh: 一種附魔效果，能賦予武器力量而將敵人拉近。
descriptionLong.en: An enchantment that grants weapons the power to pull enemies closer.

description.zh: 擊敗敵人時，有 {數值} 的機率為盟友創造強固之泉。
description.en: Defeating an enemy has a {value} chance to create a Fortifying well for allies.

descriptionLong.zh: 擊敗敵人時有機率創造一座泉水，賦予你和盟友強固狀態，而不受到敵人傷害。
descriptionLong.en: Defeating an enemy has a chance to create a well that grants you and your allies the Fortifying status, protecting you from enemies.

description.zh: 使用神器時，會恢復你最大生命值的 {數值}。
description.en: Artifact usage heals {value} of your maximum health.

descriptionLong.zh: 使用神器來恢復生命值。
descriptionLong.en: Using an artifact regenerates health.

description.zh: 使用神器時，會讓你的下一次近戰或遠程攻擊獲得 {數值} 的傷害增幅。
description.en: Artifact usage applies {value} damage amplification to your next melee or ranged attack.

descriptionLong.zh: 使用神器會提高你的下一次近戰或遠程攻擊傷害，每次使用效果都會堆疊。
descriptionLong.en: Using an artifact amplifies the damage of your next melee or ranged attack, stacking with each use.

description.zh: 跳躍攻擊會產生閃電與冰霜波動，對敵人造成傷害。
description.en: Jump attacks create waves of lightning and ice that damages enemies.

descriptionLong.zh: 一種附魔效果，能為跳躍攻擊注入冰霜與雷電之力。
descriptionLong.en: An enchantment that imbues jump attacks with ice and lightning powers.

description.zh: 額外獲得 {數值} 瓶生命藥水。
description.en: Grants {value} additional health potions.

descriptionLong.zh: 額外獲得生命藥水使用次數。
descriptionLong.en: Grants additional uses of health potion.

description.en: Increases chance of critical hits with melee attacks by {value}.

description.zh: 受到的遠程攻擊傷害降低 {數值}。

description.en: Take {value} less damage.

description.en: Increases chance to stagger enemies on hit by {value}.

description.zh: 脫離戰鬥 5 秒後，每秒恢復 {數值} 生命值。
description.en: Restores health by {value} per second after 5 seconds out of combat.

description.zh: 從負面狀態中復原的速度提高 {數值}。
description.en: Recover from negative statuses {value} faster.

description.zh: 翻滾的冷卻時間縮短 {數值}。
description.en: Reduces rolling cooldown time by {value}.

description.zh: 敵人身上的負面狀態持續時間延長 {數值}。
description.en: Increases duration of negative statuses on enemies by {value}.

description.zh: 潛影的持續時間延長 {數值}。
description.en: Shadowcloaking lasts {value} longer.

description.en: Melee attacks deal {value} more damage.

description.zh: 在遠距離時，遠程攻擊造成的傷害提高 {數值}。
description.en: Ranged attacks deal {value} more damage from far away.

description.zh: 命中敵人時，施加魂疫狀態。
description.en: Applies Soulsick status to enemies on hit.

description.zh: 靈魂攻擊造成的傷害提高 {數值}。
description.en: Soul attacks deal {value} more damage.

description.en: Increases souls gained by {value}.

description.en: Increases souls gained by {value}.

description.zh: 靈魂容量提高 {數值}。
description.en: Increases Soul capacity by {value}.

description.zh: 移動速度提高 {數值}。
description.en: Increases movement speed by {value}.

description.zh: 移動超過 {數值} 秒後，移動速度提高 {數值}。
description.en: Increases movement speed by {value} if moving for more than {value} seconds.

description.zh: 施加在自己身上的正面狀態持續時間延長 {數值}。
description.en: Increases duration of positive statuses applied to you by {value}.

description.zh: 攻擊命中時，有 {數值} 的機率獲得強力狀態。
description.en: Attacks have a {value} chance to grant the Strength status on hit.

descriptionLong.zh: 攻擊命中時，有 {數值} 的機率獲得強力狀態。
descriptionLong.en: Attacks have a {value} chance to grant the Strength status on hit.

description.zh: 命中會使傷害提高 {數值} (最高 {數值})，若 {數值} 秒內沒有造成傷害，加成就會消失。
description.en: Hits increase damage by {value} (up to a maximum of {value}), bonus is lost if no damage is dealt for {value} seconds.

description.zh: 蓄力的遠程攻擊造成的傷害提高 {數值}。
description.en: Charged ranged attacks deal {value} more damage.

description.zh: 近戰攻擊對次要目標造成的傷害提高 {數值}。
description.en: Melee attacks deal {value} more damage to secondary targets.

description.zh: 潛影期間，移動速度提高 {數值}。
description.en: Increases movement speed by {value} while Shadowcloaking.

description.zh: 攻擊命中時，有 {數值} 的機率使目標陷入嘲諷狀態。
description.en: Attacks have a {value} chance to inflict the Taunted status on hit.

description.zh: 將所受傷害的 {數值} 反彈給攻擊者。
description.en: Deals {value} of received damage back to the attacker.

description.zh: 對生命值全滿的敵人造成的傷害提高 {數值}。
description.en: Deal {value} more damage to enemies who are at full health.

description.zh: 神器攻擊造成的傷害提高 {數值}。
description.en: Artifact attacks deal {value} more damage.

description.zh: 對自己與盟友所施加的正面狀態持續時間延長 {數值}。
description.en: Positive statuses you apply to yourself and allies last {value} longer.

description.zh: 近戰與遠程攻擊速度提高。
description.en: Melee and ranged attack speed is increased.

description.zh: 神器傷害與靈魂收集量提高，且神器冷卻時間縮短。
description.en: Artifact damage and soul gathering are increased, and artifact cooldown is reduced.

description.zh: 近戰攻擊會造成額外的閃電傷害。
description.en: Melee attacks deal additional Lightning damage.

description.zh: 移動速度與近戰攻擊速度提高。
description.en: Movement speed and melee attack speed are increased.

description.zh: 近戰攻擊會造成額外的火焰傷害。
description.en: Melee attacks deal additional Fire damage.

description.zh: 近戰攻擊會造成額外的冰霜傷害。
description.en: Melee attacks deal additional Frost damage.

description.zh: 所有攻擊造成的額外傷害提高。
description.en: All attacks deal increased additive damage.

description.zh: 近戰攻擊會造成額外的劇毒傷害。
description.en: Melee attacks deal additional Poison damage.

description.zh: 近戰攻擊命中時會引發小型爆炸。
description.en: Melee attacks cause tiny explosions on hit.

description.zh: 持續受到火焰傷害。
description.en: Fire damage is being taken over time.

description.zh: 無法移動，且效果可傳播至範圍內的多個目標。
description.en: Movement is completely disabled and can spread to multiple targets within range.

description.zh: 移動速度提高，但傷害抗性大幅降低。
description.en: Movement speed is increased at the cost of greatly reduced damage resistance.

description.zh: 攻擊必定造成暴擊。
description.en: Attacks are guaranteed critical hits.

description.zh: 暴擊傷害提高。
description.en: Critical hit damage is increased.

description.zh: 所有投射物都會偏轉。
description.en: All projectiles are being deflected.

description.zh: 攻擊速度與移動速度降低。
description.en: Attack speed and movement speed are reduced.

description.zh: 會攻擊盟友，並造成更多傷害。
description.en: Attacking allies and dealing more damage.

description.zh: 神器完全無法使用。
description.en: Artifact usage is completely blocked.

description.zh: 移動速度降低。
description.en: Movement speed is reduced.

description.zh: 不會受到任何傷害。
description.en: No damage is being taken.

description.zh: 持續受到毒素傷害。
description.en: Poison damage is being taken over time.

description.zh: 生命值逐漸恢復。
description.en: Health is being gradually restored.

description.zh: 受到的所有傷害降低。
description.en: All damage taken is reduced.

description.zh: 對怪物隱形，且下一次攻擊必定造成暴擊；在進行下一次攻擊或使用神器後效果結束。
description.en: Invisible to mobs and the next attack is a critical hit, ending on the next attack or artifact use.

description.zh: 移動速度降低。
description.en: Movement speed is reduced.

description.zh: 持續受到靈魂傷害，並同時降低生命值與靈魂數量。
description.en: Soul damage is being taken over time, reducing both health and souls.

description.zh: 所有攻擊造成的乘算傷害提高。
description.en: All attacks deal increased multiplicative damage.

description.zh: 移動速度提高。
description.en: Movement speed is increased.

description.zh: 鎖定嘲諷者作為目標。
description.en: Targeting the taunter.

description.zh: 移動速度小幅提高，撞上怪物時會將其擊退並造成傷害。
description.en: Movement speed is slightly increased and running into mobs knocks them back and deals damage.

description.zh: 完全無法移動。
description.en: Movement is completely disabled.

description.zh: 造成的傷害降低，且受到的傷害提高。
description.en: Damage dealt is reduced and damage taken is increased.

description.zh: 無法翻滾或跳躍，移動速度大幅降低。
description.en: Rolling and jumping are blocked, and movement speed is greatly reduced.
